name: Scroll-built chart story
summary: The chart holds still while two to four steps scroll past; each step lights one moment and draws the line up to it. Still and complete under reduced motion and in print.
bestFor: A story with two to four beats: what was normal, what broke, what fixed it
avoidFor: Dashboards and app screens (no scroll moments there), or a single point (use the chart story)
dataShape: x + series (first is the focus) + steps: from, to, label, title, text
aliases: chart that builds as you scroll
